The '''Red Mud Potters Clan''' was a clan of [[Witches of Dathomir|Dathomiri witches]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomir]]. One of their members, [[Hacina]], was a [[Nightsisters/Legends|Nightsister]].<ref name="backlash" />
